A cohort study involving 140 128 patients receiving anti-ulcer therapy, 70 389 of whom received ranitidine, found no evidence that any of the drugs studied were associated with a major increased risk of vascular or inflammatory disorders of the eye.1 For reference to loss of colour vision in a child receiving raniti- dine see under Effects on the Nervous System, below. 1.
